announcements.headline: Exercise of Options and PDMR dealing
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates that a person discharging managerial responsibilities has exercised options and dealt in the company's shares. Such disclosures are routine regulatory filings that confirm insider activity but do not inherently signal a change in corporate strategy or financial performance.

The headline does not indicate any specific direction or magnitude of change in performance.
